source_algorithm_notes: Pillow rounded_rectangle computes diameter before coordinate round; Pythonround uses ties-even for ordinary path coordinates. Radius may clamp to a joined ellipse/halfellipse; zero diameter delegates to rectangle.

Ellipse and pieslice C bindings receive double coordinates but cast to int before Draw.c rasterization. Draw.c quarter/ellipse iteration uses integer step2 and deviation-based digital boundary, returns horizontal spans; hline clips to canvas. Analytic pixel-center circle inclusion is not equivalent.
Source caller multiplies x/y/w/h/radius by4, uses right/bottom endpoints minus1, then requires all16highres samples; clipping and asymmetric zero-size exceptions are provider behavior.
